rules.title: Security Deposit Limit - General Landlords
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.citation: Assembly Bill 12; Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.coverage_conditions: Unit is furnished or unfurnished; tenancy begins on or after July 1, 2024; landlord is not exempt small owner
rules.exemptions: Small owner exemption: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total where ownership is held by natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural person members can charge up to two months rent

rules.title: Security Deposit Limit - Small Owner Exemption
rules.requirement: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons
rules.citation: Assembly Bill 12; Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlord owns exactly two rental properties with no more than four residential units total; ownership is natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural person members; tenancy begins on or after July 1, 2024
rules.exemptions: No statutory exemptions within this category; instead this rule provides an exemption to the general one-month limit

rules.title: Pre-Tenancy Unit Photography Requirement
rules.requirement: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit

rules.title: Move-Out Walk-Through Inspection Requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning, to give tenants a chance to correct issues in order to avoid security deposit deductions
rules.citation: California state law; Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page
rules.quoted_span: Under state law, landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning
rules.coverage_conditions: During last two weeks of any tenancy in Berkeley
rules.exemptions: None stated; however document notes many landlords do not offer this inspection
rules.conflict_note: Document indicates this is state law requirement, not specific Berkeley ordinance

rules.title: Itemized Security Deposit Deduction Statement Requirement
rules.requirement: If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises, including a copy of any bill, invoice, or receipt for materials or supplies deductions

rules.title: Post-Possession Unit Photography Requirement for Deductions
rules.requirement: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit. These photos and a written explanation of the cost of the repairs/cleaning must be given to the tenant along with the itemized statement

rules.title: Professional Cleaning Services Restriction
rules.requirement: The landlord cannot require a tenant to pay for, or assert a claim against the tenant or the security deposit for professional carpet cleaning or other professional cleaning services, unless reasonably necessary to return the premises to the condition it was in at the start of the tenancy, minus ordinary wear and tear
rules.citation: California state law; Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Requirement
rules.requirement: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance; Berkeley Rent Board Security Deposits page

rules.exemptions: Units not covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance; document indicates interest requirement is specific to rent-controlled units
rules.conflict_note: Coverage dependent on unit's status under Berkeley Rent Ordinance; interest rate and calculation not specified in document
